event_chain.summary: Unauthorized access to summer registration web app

summary: District of Columbia Public Schools disclosed in late July 2026 that an unauthorized third party accessed a web-based application used for DCPS Summer Learning registration, exposing student names, student ID numbers, dates of birth, school and grade, parent/guardian names, home addresses and phone numbers for students at up to 55 schools. The ExfilSquad extortion group listed DCPS on its leak site on July 26, 2026, threatening to release the full data set if the district did not respond. DCPS removed the data from the application, engaged the DC Office of the Chief Technology Officer, and the FBI is investigating.
